message.content:
This is a Lemo/Bose-type Zulu H-MOD kit. CBP rulings on similar aviation headset kits (e.g., Bose A20 headsets) classify them under 8518.30.20 as headphones/earphones combined with a microphone. Headsets that combine earphones with a microphone fall under 8518.30.20 (HTSUS 8518.30.2000: "Headphones and earphones, whether or not combined with microphone": Other).

The 10-digit statistical suffix for 8518.30.20 is 8518.30.2000. That is the code I settled on, although I'm working from memory of similar rulings rather than a ruling on this exact item.

The kit contains ear cup speakers with microphones, a cable harness and a control box, and it forms a functional headset. Classification as a set under GRI 3(b), with the headphones giving the essential character, leads to 8518.30.
